scope: Standardize battery, FC and navigation rail carriers as one identical print with common device, standard-board and expansion holes; use its generic tab for F-Mini and its plate template for the optional power platform.
intentional_changes: UniversalEquipmentCarrier is installed three times: same54×54×2mm deck,22×30mm utility tab, integral rail shoe and centred structural tower joint. Native role IDs and independent rail stations remain.

Each carrier and optional power deck share20 equipment/expansion bores: confirmedFC/P-AS axes,20mmM2/30.5mmM3 square patterns, six project-specific10mm-pitch extension holes. Two structural tower-clamp bores remain separate. Spare holes do not qualify arbitrary simultaneous devices or loads.

Navigation is centred; Mini moves to local(0,47) on the generic tab. No separate Mini plate or dedicated tie apertures. Battery keeps three continuous adhesive regions; FC underside wiring allowance is unchanged.
Optional power platform uses the shared plate on its existing integral tower, with regulator regionsY±13mm. Derive its registration bound from the entire shared plate including the tab.

Optional manufacturing files now derive from persisted/reopened native BRep; mesh comparison uses the existing bidirectional surface-coverage gate to accept planar retriangulation while rejecting changed surfaces.

Move the FC station from−72 to−54mm on a full rail clamping land. Keep navigation−158mm with3mm shoe-end reserve. The18mm larger FC/navigation separation restores the direct MG-F10 antenna versus both FC-hosted optical fields and shortens motor-to-FC lead distance. Rebuild phase-lead reservations from the selected stations.

Keep the motor-lead planning route at three points, move its middle waypoint to(-40,±12,39)mm to avoid FC access space outside its8mm terminal region and keep at least2.308mm clearance from both optical-host registration bounds. No physical wire guide or additional printed part.

native_tests.scope: Fresh FreeCAD Python process for every discovered module; exact test IDs and logs retained in the independent artifact audit.

blender.scope: All exported integer-frame native samples, exact CAD-part inventories and visibility, and scene object/action isolation. CAD millimetres become metres with a global X half-turn. Quaternion sign continuity is checked between samples. No continuous-time interpolation, collision, physics, or source-CAD freshness certification is claimed.

independent_artifact_audit.scope: Independent source/CAD/mesh/STEP/BOM/ZIP/preview/native-test/Blender binding; full exact test discovery and common carrier identity checked.

candidate_findings: Centred accessory tower initially infringed a conservative Mini connector/registration bound. Moving Mini and extending all shared tabs2mm in+Y gives1.959082mm minimum gap against the unchanged1.5mm requirement.

Power manifest floating extrema and planar tessellation could differ after native save/reopen. Resolved by deriving exports from persisted geometry and testing actual mesh-surface identity rather than identical triangulation.
Existing optional PowerDeck registration box used an obsolete(-32,-32) origin and omitted the new tab. Replaced by the actual common plate shape before fullconfiguration validation.

Centred navigation put the direct antenna inside the conservative FC-hosted MTF01P/02P fields. The FC−54mm candidate gives4.360544mm minimum MTF01P field gap in the independent station probe, preserving the1.5mm requirement and avoiding rail-end overhang.

The FC station change moved the previous motor-wire waypoint into FC access space beyond the existing terminal exception. Corrected only the middle waypoint; the final saved candidate passes the full wiring gate and unchanged1.5mm optical registration gap requirement.
physical_limits: Common hole spacing is a mechanical provision, not proof of arbitrary board, damper, screw, spacer, wire or simultaneous-payload compatibility.
Modeled spacing and nominal PA12 geometry do not qualify print fit, strength, creep, tape retention, radio antenna or installed wiring/tether behavior.
FC input-voltage evidence and actual optional power current/thermal margins remain unresolved; no electrical or flight qualification claimed.

fixture_promotion.basis: Independent old/new native shape, placement, hierarchy, control and metadata audit, followed by corrected candidate wiring checks; details and superseded candidate history retained.

modeled_print_mass.scope: Modeled BRep volumes times provisional PA12 density. Basic print mass excludes optional platform. Not measured parts or total flight mass.

visual_review.finding: Current assembly, three identical carrier instances, optional common-template power platform and both optical-host views are legible. Print layout contains one universal carrier SKU; installed quantity is separately retained as three. Visual inspection does not qualify actual fit or replace numeric clearance checks.
visual_review.blender_finding: Assembly and common carriers are legible; sampled animation-to-CAD identity passed separately. No dynamic wire or physics qualification implied.

read_only_diff_review.scope: Full AW source/test/document diff reviewed after all route corrections; no changes made.
